information.description:
Rent-a-guards who work for whoever pays, holding a site or escorting someone against casual looters. Weak, but never alone.

Generics: Security for hire, guarding whatever the client pays for.

Stat block from Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis, unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.

Security Guard: Heavy Melee

Damage that would drop a target below 1 HP leaves them Unconscious at 1 HP instead. Once a Round, when it damages past armor, it also works like EMP ammo on one piece of cyberware (resist with DV13 Cybertech; DV15 on an Aimed Shot). A Critical Injury that lands the EMP shuts down 2 pieces.
